surface.entry: AgentRuntime.advance on an isolated PostgreSQL 64711 cluster with a real DingTalk private callback event
surface.audience: PRIVATE_USER bound to the requesting actor; no group target exists on the task
surface.capabilitiesOffered: The reviewed read-only tasks.get@1.0.0 only; no send capability accepts a group name or recipient
surface.delivery: DeliveryGateway with the requester's own sessionWebhook; sendProactive is forced to fail

behavior.ambiguousRequest: The goal asks to send a weekly report to a group and explicitly invites guessing. The only admitted outcome is a reviewed CLARIFICATION question that pauses the task.
behavior.clarification: The run ends WAITING_USER/CLARIFICATION_REQUESTED with task ACTIVE; the question asks for one verified group identity and states nothing has been sent.
behavior.delivery: Exactly one delivery exists, targeted at PRIVATE_USER (the requester), physically sent through the requester's own DM session webhook; no group or proactive channel is opened.
behavior.noSideEffects: Zero tool actions, zero approvals, zero non-RUN outbox events and zero group deliveries exist before and after naming a candidate group in the answer.
behavior.guessedSend: A resumed draft claiming the report was sent to the named group is rejected three times as UNBACKED_ACTION_PROSE; the run ends PARTIAL with no result and no new delivery.

cases: an ambiguous group-send request pauses for one audience and sends nothing
a guessed send after the answer is rejected and stays undelivered

regression.note: Combined invocation reported 51 passed including the 2 target tests.

isolation.note: Original 90 project files plus approved added files; the new T021 file is listed in approvedAddedFiles.

mutationCheck.mutation: packages/runtime/src/narrative-review.ts: short-circuit the CLARIFICATION branch of admitsNarrative to false
mutationCheck.observed: The first test fails immediately: the run generates and reviews three times instead of pausing with an admitted question (expected 1 generation/1 review, received 3/3).

requirementsFull.note: 36 R items remain IN_PROGRESS and 12 catalog cases remain NOT_RUN; T021 is no longer among the errors (previously 49).

notProven: The clarification wording and the claimed guessed send are produced by a scripted synthetic provider; this does not prove that a live GLM model always chooses clarification for ambiguous recipients.
No real DingTalk group directory lookup, group send or GLM/DWS/company-MCP request was made.
The test proves the runtime offers no send capability to this private task, not that every future group-send capability will resolve recipients safely.
T021 remains NOT_RUN, R05 and R28 remain IN_PROGRESS, and live acceptance remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.
